scope: Every finite p≥2; original normalized psi family, squared-gap extension and actual contour-moment atlas constructed together. One connected open complex neighborhood containing the full real source locus.

clauses.details: Exact factorization at every k≠n, including collapsed gaps. Actual canonical coefficient is fixed independently of q, zero at k=n, in every finite ℓq with q>1; norm bound uniform in n and locally uniform at every complex source.
Positive bound selected before source and deleted index; summability and q-power sum of the actual coefficient sequence.
SourceSecondMomentMixedData.diagonal provides fixed maps into ℓ^(p/2) and the algebraic intersection of every finite ℓq, q>1; local norm bounds for all projections. Both maps chosen before q.
Consumes the verified refined estimate, whose half-exponent lower bound equals one at p=2.

quantifiers: The common source domain, and the local neighborhood at each complex source, precede every auxiliary exponent. The same atlas supplies all clauses.
does_not_establish: Analyticity of the infinite weighted moment sum or its weighted frequency-sequence maps.
Main Theorem 1.3 or the flow statements of Theorem 1.1.
